questions: How does the increasing axisymmetry of the dust ring for Z>0.03 and the emission line profiles from a compact disk at an inclination of ~24 degrees relate to the dynamics of protoplanetary disks?
In what ways might the efficient decoupling of dust from gas during early stages influence the interpretation of CO depletion in relation to turbulence constraints in protoplanetary disks?
What is the nature of the interactions between dust, gas, and emerging planetary bodies in protoplanetary disks?
How might the expected interferometric signatures from radiative transfer models of magnetospheric accretion inform our understanding of the fundamental processes driving Br-gamma emission?
Could the presence of asymmetries within one arcsecond in protoplanetary disks challenge the prevailing theories of uniformity in disk formation and planet development?
